body: -- Founder: 'ok where is my social funnel? at least a login button at the top?' The auth strip was already live on every page but rendered completely empty (JS did 'if (!clientId) return' with no fallback) since GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID isn't configured yet (S176-34). Now shows a disabled 'Sign in (coming soon)' pill. Live-verified with a real Playwright/Chromium browser: pill text confirmed, visible=true, zero page errors. Commit eba56df.
title: Sign-in funnel now visible even before GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is configured
